description: This file defines the ConnectCampaignsV2Client class, which extends AwsClient and provides an interface to interact with Amazon Connect Campaigns V2 Service. It includes method docblocks for various campaign-related operations, indicating methods for creating, deleting, describing, and updating campaigns and related resources.

classes.name: ConnectCampaignsV2Client
classes.description: Client class for interacting with Amazon Connect Campaigns V2 Service, extending AwsClient to facilitate API calls and asynchronous operations.

methods.name: createCampaign
methods.description: Creates a new campaign with specified arguments.

methods.name: deleteCampaign
methods.description: Deletes an existing campaign identified by arguments.

methods.name: describeCampaign
methods.description: Provides details about a specific campaign.

methods.name: getCampaignState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of a specified campaign.

methods.name: putConnectInstanceIntegration
methods.description: Creates or updates an instance integration.

methods.name: updateCampaignName
methods.description: Updates the name of a campaign.
